# WO-125: Keep the onBrand button readable on hover (CA-1)
Status: open (local start: tools/copilot.sh start WO-125)
Vendor: copilot
Agent: web-builder
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (CLAUDE_TO_COPILOT.md; check-ins via tools/copilot.sh checkin)
Assigned to: Ben Adler (Copilot web-builder), Lucia Ferraro reviews the colour choice. Local Copilot CLI
Source: GP-04 (COPILOT_PROPOSALS.md), accepted in CLAUDE-P006

## Goal
`docs/vendor/web-contrast-audit.md` CA-1: `web/src/components/ui/button-variants.ts` `onBrand` uses
`hover:bg-bg-alt`, which gives about 1.15:1 text contrast on hover in dark mode (home final CTA,
`CtaDownload look="onBrand"`). Change the hover so the label stays readable in both themes.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Hover text contrast at least 4.5:1 in light AND dark, computed from the token values in `web/src/styles/tokens.css`
  (read them, do not hard-code). Report both ratios in VENDOR_STATUS.md.
- New test `tests/test_web_button_hover_contrast.py` parses the onBrand class string and the tokens and asserts the
  hover pair passes 4.5:1 in both themes. Offline, no new dependencies.
- `cd web && pnpm build && pnpm check` pass; `.venv/bin/python -m ruff check tests/test_web_button_hover_contrast.py` passes;
  run the new test and `tests/test_web_*.py -q` with your worktree .venv and report real numbers.
- If no existing token works, STOP and ask in VENDOR_STATUS.md Questions (tokens.css is not in scope).

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- web/src/components/ui/button-variants.ts
- tests/test_web_button_hover_contrast.py (new)
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
web/src/styles/tokens.css, web/src/pages/, Section.astro (CA-2), every existing test. No scratch files.
